Seafile 14.0.9, with the Ubuntu and Python security fixes published since upstream built its image, and a compose file for Docker hosts other than Unraid.

## ✨ Added

- **A compose file for other Docker hosts.** `compose.yaml` runs Seafile on any Linux server with Docker. The README explains the setup on Synology, Proxmox, MOS, ZimaOS, CasaOS and umbrelOS.

## 🎨 Design

- The README has buttons for the MOS Hub, the ZimaOS and Umbrel app stores and the compose file.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Seafile 14.0.9.** Upstream still labels Seafile 14 as testing, so back up the data folder and the database before you update.
- **Ubuntu security updates and dnspython 2.9.0 in Seahub.** The image installs the Ubuntu fixes published since upstream built it. PyJWT 2.15.1, certifi 2026.10.23 and pip 26.2.2 replace older versions with open advisories, both in the system and in the copies Seahub brings along.
